blindSummary:
This state/province was the fifth of the regional authorities to adopt a "anti-LGBT ideology" resolution by June 2020, completing the configuration that at peak covered about a third of national territory across roughly 100 municipalities and five regions. It sits in the same conservative-region belt as several siblings, and its resolution was annulled or repealed in the 2020-2021 wave of court rulings and external funding pressure.

No march ban, violence episode, or holdout municipality comparable to the late holdouts documented elsewhere in the country is recorded at the state/province scale. The visitor-facing signal is the regional declaration's intent to exclude LGBTQ public presence and the social climate of the governing conservative party's voter base; the formal legal document is now absent.
blindSourceSummaries: Encyclopedia overview of the country's 'LGBT-free zones': by June 2020 about 100 municipalities and five regional authorities - this state/province the last adopter completing the five - had passed resolutions covering a third of the country; symbolic and unenforceable but stigmatising, lobbied for by a conservative legal institute; every such resolution had been repealed or court-invalidated by spring 2025.

Legal-overview article on the rise and fall of the country's LGBT-free zones: between 2019 and 2025 more than 100 local governments adopted 'LGBT ideology'-free resolutions or family-rights charters drafted by a conservative legal institute, covering about a third of the country at the movement's peak; the documents created no criminal penalties but symbolically sidelined LGBT residents from civic life; litigation by the national human-rights commissioner led courts to strike them down as unconstitutional, a supranational funding body threatened to freeze billions in regional funds, and the last remaining zone was abolished in spring 2025.
blindTangential: The regional resolution targeted 'LGBT ideology' broadly rather than trans people as such; with the document gone, what remains visitor-facing is the declaration-era civic climate of the governing conservative party's core support regions, not any unit-specific instrument.
